court: U.S. District Court, Southern District of New York
claim_type: Beyonce.com inaccessible to blind users — no alt text on images, inaccessible menus, no keyboard navigation, mouse-only interaction required
estimated_defense_cost: Not disclosed; settled in 2019 within months of filing

sources.name: Hollywood Reporter — Beyonce's Parkwood Entertainment sued
Billboard — Beyonce's Parkwood Entertainment sued over website accessibility
Fortune — Why your website might not be ADA compliant
Law.com — Blind fan sues over Beyonce website

summary_one_line: Beyoncé's entertainment company sued by blind fan over inaccessible website; generated massive press coverage and demonstrates that even non-retail businesses face liability.
notes: Filed January 3, 2019 by Mary Conner, a legally blind self-described 'big fan.' Specific allegations: image-based interface with no alt text, inaccessible drop-down menus, no keyboard access. Sought class action status for all legally blind U.S. users who attempted to access the site. High PR value for report — illustrates no business is too 'hip' or non-traditional to be sued. Outcome: settled, terms confidential. No primary source on settlement terms available.
